prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Pet is Awakening", "Test out your pet's voice pitch and desktop footsteps while background assets finish downloading.", "Play Voice Pitch Preview", "Asset Download Progress"]
1: ["Ready to Launch Desktop Pet", "Your companion is ready to step onto your desktop screen. Click below to verify display permissions and spawn.", "Spawn Pet on Desktop", "System Ready", "Test Window Overlay"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype", "Select a ready-to-spawn companion personality and skip photo upload wait times.", "Adopt Instantly", "Select Archetype"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick a instant preset companion or create a custom visual pet from photos.", "Choose Instant vs Custom"]
4: ["Signing in automatically restores previously adopted pets tied to your email.", "Your pet progress and personality data are saved securely to your account."]
5: ["Assembling desktop animations, sound effects, and behavioral loops."]
6: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Master these quick key shortcuts to manage your pet while working.", "Controls Overview"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is being registered. If custom generation takes extra time, high-quality fallback assets will ensure instant spawn.", "Finalize Adoption"]
8: ["Bonus: 3 Free Starter Toys Included"]
9: ["Play Ready Chime"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus gifts.
